faqs.question: What is this internship?
faqs.answer: This internship provides practical experience through project-based learning in AI and Data Science.

faqs.question: How can I register?
faqs.answer: You can register by saying 'I want to register'. I will guide you through the registration process.

faqs.question: What information is required?
faqs.answer: The registration requires your name, email address, and field of study.

faqs.question: Which fields of study are supported?
faqs.answer: Supported fields include Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, ECE, EEE, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Information Technology.

faqs.question: Can I correct my information?
faqs.answer: Yes. Before final confirmation, you can choose the information you want to correct.

faqs.question: What happens after registration?
faqs.answer: After you confirm your details, your registration is saved successfully.

faqs.question: Can I register again?
faqs.answer: Each email address can be registered only once. If an email is already registered, you need to provide a different email address.

faqs.question: How can I get help?
faqs.answer: You can type 'help' at any time and I will explain how I can assist you.
